title: HPP Error Code Registry
description: Canonical registry of all HPP error codes. Every implementation — browser extension, mobile SDK, native client — MUST use these exact codes. Display messages are localization-ready.

HPP_EXTENSION_NOT_FOUND.display_message: The HPP extension is not installed or not active on this page.
HPP_EXTENSION_NOT_FOUND.cause: HPP.requestPresence() was called but no extension dispatched hpp-extension-ready.
HPP_EXTENSION_NOT_FOUND.resolution: Install the HPP client (browser extension, mobile SDK, or native module).

HPP_TIMEOUT.cause: The user did not complete biometric verification within timeoutMs (default 60000ms).
HPP_TIMEOUT.resolution: Retry. The user may need to be prompted again.

HPP_WEBAUTHN_CANCELLED.cause: The user dismissed the WebAuthn biometric prompt (NotAllowedError).
HPP_WEBAUTHN_CANCELLED.resolution: Retry when the user is ready to verify.

HPP_UV_FLAG_MISSING.display_message: Biometric verification was not confirmed by the authenticator.
HPP_UV_FLAG_MISSING.cause: The platform authenticator produced an assertion without the UV (User Verified) flag set. This violates INV-1.
HPP_UV_FLAG_MISSING.resolution: Ensure the device has a working biometric sensor and that userVerification is not being downgraded by browser settings.

HPP_ORIGIN_MISMATCH.display_message: This site's origin does not match any enrolled HPP credential.
HPP_ORIGIN_MISMATCH.cause: The computed rpId from the page origin does not match any enrolled site, or the rpId computed client-side differs from server-side.
HPP_ORIGIN_MISMATCH.resolution: The user must enroll on this site first, or the site's domain has changed since enrollment.

HPP_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE.display_message: The HPP verification server is temporarily unavailable.
HPP_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE.cause: Network error, server timeout, or unexpected HTTP status from the verifier server.
HPP_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE.resolution: Retry after a brief delay. If persistent, check server status.

HPP_CHALLENGE_SIG_INVALID.display_message: The verification challenge could not be validated.
HPP_CHALLENGE_SIG_INVALID.cause: The server_sig on the challenge response failed ECDSA verification. Possible MITM or server key rotation.
HPP_CHALLENGE_SIG_INVALID.resolution: Do not proceed. The challenge may be tampered. Refresh and retry.

HPP_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED.display_message: The verification window has expired. Please try again.
HPP_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED.cause: The attestation arrived outside the window_ms enforcement period.
HPP_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED.resolution: Fetch a new challenge and retry.

HPP_CHALLENGE_STALE.cause: The challenge server_timestamp is older than max_clock_skew_ms allows.

HPP_CLOCK_SKEW.cause: The difference between client time and server_timestamp exceeds max_clock_skew_ms.

HPP_UNKNOWN_EXTENSION_ID.display_message: This HPP client is not recognized by the verification server.
HPP_UNKNOWN_EXTENSION_ID.cause: The X-HPP-Extension-ID header is not in the server's allowlist.

CERT_SIG_INVALID.cause: hpp_server_sig does not match the canonical payload when verified against the HPP public key.
CERT_SIG_INVALID.resolution: Reject the certificate. Do not grant access.

RP_MISMATCH.cause: The rp_id in the certificate does not match the relying party's expected domain.

ALREADY_USED.display_message: This certificate has already been used.
ALREADY_USED.cause: cert_id exists in the replay prevention store.

NONCE_ALREADY_USED.display_message: Challenge nonce has already been consumed.
NONCE_ALREADY_USED.cause: The nonce was used in a previous attestation.

CREDENTIAL_REVOKED.display_message: This device credential has been revoked.
CREDENTIAL_REVOKED.cause: The credential_id has been revoked via DELETE /v1/credential.

ACTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH.display_message: Re-attestation action scope does not match.
ACTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH.cause: The action_scope in the certificate does not match the expected value for the protected action.
ACTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH.resolution: Reject. Request re-attestation with correct action scope.
